Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning appeals of water quantity decisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the waterrelated actions of the department ofecology; and adding a new section to chapter 43.21B RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21B RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person who is aggrieved or adversely affected by a waterquantity decision may appeal the decision to the pollution controlhearings board under RCW 43.21B.310, or to the superior court where theland is located upon which the water is or would be used. Any appealto the superior court shall be de novo. (2) A person who appeals a decision to the pollution controlhearings board under subsection (1) of this section may appeal theboard's decision directly to the court of appeals. (3) For purposes of this section, a "water quantity decision"includes the following: (a) A decision to grant or deny a permit or certificate for a rightto the beneficial use of water or to amend, change, or transfer such aright; and p. 1 SSB 5086 (b) A decision to enforce the conditions of a permit for, or rightto, the beneficial use of water or to require any person to discontinuethe use of water.
